subject: VIP donor giftset personalization: vendor lead times and serialization
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sara Blake <sara@brightwork.co>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: VIP donor giftset personalization: vendor lead times and serialization

Team / Sara —

We have an ask from Arbor Health: 120 VIP donor giftsets for the summit on Mar 8. Each set is a branded insulated metal tumbler (our logo) plus a small curated snack box. For 40 of these sets we need engraving with the donor's names (full names, some with accents — see attached engraving_spec.csv).

Key constraints:
- Event onsite delivery to the hotel on Mar 7 (hotel will sign for goods).
- Remaining 80 sets can be distributed post-event from our office or shipped direct to VIPs.
- Budget: originally routed for standard production; we can approve a rush premium if needed but want clear costs.

Asks:
1) Sara — can Brightwork confirm lead time for 120 sets with 40 personalized engravings? If personalization adds days, what are partial-ship options (e.g., ship 60 core-branded sets by Mar 3 and the personalized batch later)?
2) Please include serialization/kit packing options (do you apply sequential serial numbers, and can you provide a CSV mapping SKU -> serial?)
3) If metal tumblers are backordered, what are alternate supplier options and additional cost for rush air?

Attachments: design_proof_v3.pdf, engraving_spec.csv

I want to lock vendor direction by EOD Monday so we can confirm hotel receiving and any customs paperwork.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

--
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Blake <sara@brightwork.co>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VIP donor giftset personalization: vendor lead times and serialization

Hi Neha / team —

Thanks for the brief and the files. Quick summary after checking with production:

Production / lead times
- Standard (no personalization): 18 business days from PO and artwork approval.
- Personalization (engraving names): additional 7–10 business days because names require manual proofing for accents and layout.
- Current supplier note: the metal tumbler vendor has a PO backlog; earliest inbound is Mar 10 unless we confirm air-forwarding of a partial lot from their EU plant.

Partial-ship options
- We can split the order: 60 standard sets ready to ship by Mar 3 (ocean + expedited inland) and remaining 60 (including 40 personalized) by Mar 16 if standard routing.
- Rush option (air freight + overtime engraving): can deliver remaining 60 by Mar 5–6, additional cost ~ $1,950 for air + $820 overtime engraving. Exact quote attached (brightwork_quote_rev2.pdf).

Serialization & packing
- We can laser-engrave sequential serials and deliver CSV mapping SKU->serial. If you want donor name association encoded in a serial field we can add that as a custom column.

Notes on accents
- Names with diacritics: we will provide proofs before engraving; some characters require specialized tooling and may add manual review time.

Next steps
1) Confirm whether you want the partial-ship (60 by Mar 3) and whether we should pursue the air-rush for the balance.
2) Provide final donor name CSV by EOD Tue so we can start proofing.

Attached: brightwork_quote_rev2.pdf

Best,
Sara Blake
Account Lead — Brightwork Creative
sara@brightwork.co | +1 617-555-2590

--
Brightwork Creative
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Blake <sara@brightwork.co>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alan Cheng <alan@globalfreight.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VIP donor giftset personalization: vendor lead times and serialization

Thanks, Sara. A couple logistics points from my side:

1) Hotel receiving — the conference hotel will accept a partial delivery on Mar 7 but needs a bill of lading + COO (country of origin) on file for metal goods. We will not have customs cleared without that.
2) If Brightwork can do 60 on Mar 3, we want those to be the non-personalized core kits to ensure 60 onsite.
3) For the personalized units: option A (air freight) makes sense if costs are within the quote. Option B is ship-to-bonded-warehouse + cleared DDP to hotel (slower but cheaper).

Alan (GlobalFreight) — can you confirm customs timeline and whether bonded clearance is feasible from your side? Also confirm DDP cost range so we can compare to Brightwork's air quote.

Priyom — can you flag budget for the incremental freight & overtime engraving if we go the rush route?

Thanks,
Mateo
Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alan Cheng <alan@globalfreight.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Sara Blake <sara@brightwork.co>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 12:51:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VIP donor giftset personalization: vendor lead times and serialization

Hi Mateo / Neha —

Short answer: bonded clearance is available and is the lower-risk route to avoid a full customs hold, but it requires correct COO paperwork and a commercial invoice that specifies metal tumblers and the non-commercial nature (gift/marketing samples) for expedited handling.

Estimate / options:
- Bonded warehouse -> local release (48–72 hours after arrival if paperwork is clean). Estimated DDP uplift: $1,100–$1,300 for the partial lot (60 units) delivered to hotel.
- Air-freight direct to hotel (rush): 24–48 hours clearance but additional $1,950 as Brightwork quoted + local handling (~$220).

Action items we can pick up:
1) I need a signed packing list + COO (we can use the template attached) and the commercial invoice marked as gift/sample to minimize duties.
2) If you confirm bonded route, please CC me on the PO so I can coordinate arrival slots with the bonded operator.

Attachment: customs_declaration.pdf

Regards,
Alan Cheng
GlobalFreight Logistics
alan@globalfreight.com | +1 206-555-7700

--
GlobalFreight Logistics

Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: VIP donor giftset personalization: vendor lead times and serialization

Folks —

Given the event Mar 8 and the vendor's inbound showing Mar 10, I recommend we:
- Approve Brightwork's partial-ship: 60 standard kits by Mar 3 to the hotel.
- Approve rush air for remaining 60 (so we can get at least 40 personalized in time) — budget up to $3,200 total (covers Brightwork air + brokerage).
- As a contingency, switch personalization for 20 of the lower-tier VIPs to a removable engraved plate/sticker applied post-event so we don't miss deadlines.

Priyom — please mark the PO with an allowance for the $3.2k rush premium and confirm. I need the final donor name CSV no later than EOD today so Brightwork can start proofs.

Laura Bennett
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-3302

Jason — quick update for Arbor Health: we are moving forward with a split delivery to guarantee at least 60 giftsets onsite for Mar 7 (hotel receiving). Brightwork will ship 60 standard kits by Mar 3. We are approving a rush option for the remaining 60 to try to include the 40 engraved VIPs; Brightwork and our freight partner are coordinating.

What this means for Arbor Health:
- Onsite: ~60 complete giftsets available at registration on Mar 8.
- Remaining sets: expected delivered to us or to VIPs between Mar 5–Mar 16 depending on routing (we will confirm exact dates by Friday).
- If any personalization cannot be completed in time, we will provide a tasteful engraved plate that can be applied after the event for up to 20 donors.

We will follow up with the final donor name list and a tracking link as soon as we have PO + proofs processed. Thanks for your flexibility — we want to make sure VIPs receive quality items without compromising production finish.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
